newsitem.title: UK: IFC emerging market index unchanged.
newsitem.headline: IFC emerging market index unchanged.

text.p: The International Finance Corporation's composite index of emerging market equities, denominated in dollars IFC/IPRD, was unchanged at 295.83 at the start of play on Thursday.
Latin America edged down 0.4 percent day-on-day to 522.80, Asia was down 0.1 at 257.30, and the Europe, Middle East and Africa were up 0.9 percent at 136.81.
The IFC composite index touched a 1996 high of 308.77 on July 4, up from the year's 275.79 low, recorded on January 1.
The IFC index measures returns on equities, liquid and accessible to foreign investors, from 26 emerging market countries. It is updated at 2300 GMT.
The J.P. Morgan emerging market local currency index ELMI, its returns calculated in dollar terms, firmed 0.08 percent to 123.55.
By region, Latin America was up 0.02 percent at 99.74, Asia rose 0.01 to 130.64, and East Europe was up 0.07 at 162.41.
